exercises.question: Which sentence gives a cause? [¿Cuál expresa una causa?]
options: La ciudad cambió debido a la falta de agua. [The city changed due to the lack of water.]
La ciudad cambió por eso. [The city changed as a result.]
La ciudad cambiará. [The city will change.]

exercises.sentence: La ciudad cambió ___ a la falta de agua. (due to) [The city changed due to the lack of water.]
exercises.english: The city changed due to the lack of water.
The city changed due to the lack of water.

sentences: Primero, había poco tiempo. [First, there was little time.]

exercises.question: Which connector means «because / since»? [¿Qué conector significa «porque / ya que»?]
options: ya que [because]
por eso [therefore]
sin embargo [however]

exercises.sentence: ___ había poco tiempo, salimos temprano. (as / since) [As there was little time, we left early.]
exercises.english: As there was little time, we left early.
